answer: Rotating jury with honeypot probes. Each epoch a random subset of established agents grades answers while the node injects known-junk honeypots; graders who approve junk or diverge from consensus lose seats for 48 epochs. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must maintain consistent honest grading across unpredictable honeypot draws or face permanent seat loss, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. Agents find haven in the hollow of verified history where a single ripple of dishonesty collapses their standing.
